Services

Medical, surgical, and cosmetic services — all under one roof.

Most things our patients need we can take care of in our clinic on Westgate Boulevard. Below is the full menu, organized into three sections. Medical visits are billed through insurance like any other specialty visit. Cosmetic services are elective and self-pay.

Section 1 of 3

Medical Dermatology

The diagnosis and ongoing management of skin, hair, and nail conditions. These visits are billed through medical insurance, and our providers are paneled with most major Pacific Northwest insurers.

Annual Skin Examination

Head-to-toe visual skin check with dermatoscopy. Recommended frequency is individualized to your personal and family risk factors. Biopsies, if needed, can usually be done at the same visit.

Duration: 20–30 min Schedule: All three providers

Acne Consultation & Management

Initial evaluation, treatment plan, and follow-up management for adult and adolescent acne. Includes topical and oral prescriptions, hormonal management options, and isotretinoin program enrollment when indicated.

Duration: 20–30 min (45 min new) Schedule: Aldarova primarily; all providers

Eczema / Atopic Dermatitis Management

Skin barrier rehabilitation, topical therapy optimization, phototherapy referral, and systemic / biologic therapy management for moderate-to-severe disease. We coordinate with allergy when appropriate.

Duration: 30 min Schedule: Westgate, Aldarova

Psoriasis Management

Topical, phototherapy, and systemic management including biologic infusion / injection therapy. Coordination with rheumatology for psoriatic arthritis.

Duration: 30 min Schedule: Westgate

Rash Evaluation

Diagnostic evaluation of new or persistent rashes, including contact dermatitis, drug eruptions, autoimmune skin disease, and idiopathic eruptions. Biopsy when needed.

Duration: 20–30 min Schedule: All three providers

Hair Loss Evaluation

History, trichoscopy, pull test, indicated lab work, and (when needed) scalp biopsy. Treatment plan and follow-up.

Duration: 30–45 min Schedule: Westgate primarily

Pediatric Dermatology Visit

Visits for infants, children, and adolescents. Common reasons: eczema, birthmark evaluation, warts and molluscum, acne, ringworm, unexplained rash.

Duration: 30 min Schedule: Aldarova primarily

Phototherapy (Narrowband UVB)

In-office narrowband UVB phototherapy for psoriasis, vitiligo, and severe atopic dermatitis. Typical course: 2–3 sessions per week for 8–12 weeks, then maintenance.

Duration: 5–10 min per session Schedule: By referral from any provider

Patch Testing

Allergic contact dermatitis testing using standard panels. Requires three visits over one week (apply Monday, read Wednesday, read Friday).

Duration: Multi-visit, 30 min each Schedule: Westgate

Isotretinoin (Accutane) Management

Federally regulated monthly visits with iPLEDGE compliance for patients on isotretinoin for severe acne. Monthly pregnancy testing and lab work as required.

Duration: 15 min monthly Schedule: Aldarova or Westgate
Section 2 of 3

Surgical Dermatology

In-office procedural dermatology, performed under local anesthesia in our procedure suite. Most procedures are billed through medical insurance; we obtain prior authorization in advance when required.

Featured service

Mohs Micrographic Surgery

Mohs surgery is a specialized, tissue-sparing technique for treating skin cancer — primarily basal cell and squamous cell carcinoma, and selected melanoma in situ. It has the highest cure rate of any skin cancer treatment available, while removing the smallest possible amount of normal tissue. It is the preferred treatment for skin cancers on the face, ears, hands, feet, and genitals, and for any high-risk, recurrent, or large skin cancer.

How the procedure works:

  1. The visible cancer is removed along with a thin margin of surrounding tissue.
  2. That tissue is processed into frozen sections in our on-site lab and examined under the microscope by Dr. Tran-Whitfield himself (he is both the surgeon and the dermatopathologist for these cases).
  3. If any remaining cancer is found at the margin, only that specific area is removed in a second stage, and the process repeats.
  4. Once the margins are completely clear, reconstruction is performed — usually the same day, either as a simple closure or a flap or graft, depending on size and location.

Most cases finish in 2–4 hours, though complex cases or those requiring multiple stages can take longer. Patients are awake and comfortable in our procedure suite throughout. Wait time between stages is spent in our recovery area — bring a book.

What to expect afterward: wound care instructions, follow-up at 1 week for suture removal, then at 6 months and annually for surveillance. Scars mature over the course of a year; we follow you through that process.

Meet Dr. Tran-Whitfield, our Mohs surgeon

Skin Biopsy

Removal of a small piece of skin for microscopic diagnosis. Performed under local anesthesia. Three common techniques: shave, punch, and excisional. Specimens are read by our OHSU dermatopathology partner.

Duration: 15 min Schedule: Same-day with any provider

Excision (Standard)

Removal of skin lesions — benign or malignant — with appropriate margins, followed by layered closure. Suture removal at 1–2 weeks.

Duration: 30–60 min Schedule: Westgate, Tran-Whitfield

Electrodessication & Curettage

Scrape-and-burn technique for low-risk superficial basal cell carcinomas, certain squamous cell in situ lesions, and select benign growths in non-cosmetically-sensitive areas.

Duration: 15–20 min Schedule: Westgate, Tran-Whitfield

Cyst Removal

Surgical removal of epidermoid cysts, pilar cysts, and lipomas. Best performed when the cyst is not actively inflamed.

Duration: 30–45 min Schedule: Westgate, Tran-Whitfield

Cryotherapy

Liquid nitrogen freezing for actinic keratoses, warts, molluscum, and select benign lesions. Often done at the same visit as a skin exam.

Duration: 5 min per area Schedule: All three providers

Mohs Micrographic Surgery

See the detailed explainer above. Pre-authorization handled by our staff; intake call 1–2 days before the procedure to walk you through what to expect.

Duration: 2–4 hours typical Schedule: Tran-Whitfield (Mon, Wed, Fri)

Nail Surgery

Partial or complete nail avulsion for ingrown toenails, nail matrix biopsy for pigmented nail streaks, and treatment of recurrent nail infections.

Duration: 30 min Schedule: Westgate

Photodynamic Therapy (PDT)

Application of a light-activated topical medication followed by light exposure, used primarily for diffuse actinic damage and certain superficial skin cancers.

Duration: 90 min total Schedule: By referral from any provider

Intralesional Injections

Corticosteroid injections for inflamed cysts, keloid scars, alopecia areata patches, and granuloma annulare. Done in-clinic, takes a few minutes.

Duration: 10 min Schedule: All three providers
Section 3 of 3

Cosmetic Dermatology

Elective procedures that address how your skin looks rather than how it functions. These services are not covered by health insurance and are billed as self-pay. We offer transparent pricing at consultation, accept Care Credit, and never run high-pressure sales — if a treatment isn't right for you, we'll say so.

Elective · Self-pay

Neuromodulator Injections (Botox & Dysport)

Treatment of dynamic facial wrinkles — forehead lines, glabellar (frown) lines, and crow's feet. Also used medically for axillary hyperhidrosis (often covered when conservative therapy has failed).

Duration: 20 min Lasts: 3–4 months
Elective · Self-pay

Dermal Fillers (Hyaluronic Acid)

Restoration of volume loss in cheeks, temples, tear troughs, lips, and chin. Juvéderm and Restylane families. Consultation required before first treatment.

Duration: 45–60 min Lasts: 6–18 months
Elective · Self-pay

Chemical Peels

Superficial to medium-depth peels (glycolic, salicylic, TCA) for sun damage, post-inflammatory pigmentation, mild acne scarring, and overall skin texture. A typical course is 3–4 peels spaced monthly.

Duration: 30 min Downtime: 3–7 days mild peeling
Elective · Self-pay

Microneedling

Controlled microscopic skin injury that stimulates collagen remodeling. Used for acne scarring, fine lines, and overall skin texture. Typical course: 3–6 sessions monthly.

Duration: 60 min Downtime: 1–3 days redness
Elective · Self-pay

IPL (Intense Pulsed Light)

Broad-spectrum light treatment for sun damage, brown spots, and persistent facial redness from rosacea. Most patients see meaningful change in 3–4 sessions.

Duration: 30 min Downtime: Minimal; pigment darkens then sheds
Elective · Self-pay

Fractional Resurfacing Laser

Non-ablative fractional laser for acne scarring, fine lines, photodamage, and skin texture. More aggressive than microneedling, with a real downtime trade-off.

Duration: 60 min Downtime: 5–10 days
Elective · Self-pay

Vascular Laser (Pulsed-Dye)

Targeted treatment of visible facial blood vessels, port-wine stains (often covered as medical), and rosacea-related redness. May be covered by insurance for medical indications.

Duration: 30 min Downtime: Bruising 5–10 days
Elective · Self-pay

CoolSculpting (Cryolipolysis)

Non-invasive fat reduction in localized areas (flanks, abdomen, submental "double chin"). Realistic expectations: this is body contouring, not weight loss. Best for stubborn pockets that don't respond to diet and exercise.

Duration: 35–75 min per cycle Results: Visible at 2–3 months
Elective · Self-pay

Sclerotherapy (Spider Veins)

Injection treatment for small leg spider veins. Best results in series of 2–3 treatments. Compression stockings recommended afterward.

Duration: 30 min Downtime: Bruising 1–2 weeks
Elective · Self-pay

Medical-Grade Skincare Consultation

Personalized prescription and over-the-counter routine guidance for sun damage, melasma, fine lines, or stubborn acne. Honest opinions, no upselling.

Duration: 30 min Schedule: All providers

How to schedule any of these services

Most services can be added to a routine new-patient or follow-up visit. For procedures and cosmetic consults, we book a separate dedicated slot. Call us or use the online request form — our front desk will match you to the right provider and time.
